summary: How puts two bent hands together at the knuckles and rolls them open until the palms face up, with lowered eyebrows.
movement: Hands rotate open from knuckles-together to palms-up
steps: Bend both hands and place them together, knuckles touching, thumbs up.
Roll them forward and open until both palms face up.
Eyebrows down. For 'how are you,' follow it with a point to YOU.
mistakes: Starting palms-up. The sign begins with the knuckles together and ends palms-up; the rotation is the sign.
